item.title: RimWorld Traits to Avoid — Worst Pawn Traits (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Some RimWorld traits actively hurt your colony. Here's the list of traits to avoid, especially on starting colonists, for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Traits to Avoid on Starting Colonists TraitWhy to avoid PyromaniacRandomly starts fires — threatens base and pawns. Chemical InterestRandom drug binges and addiction risk. LazyGlobal work speed -20%, drags productivity. WimpDowned easily by pain — a liability in combat. Greedy / JealousRequire impressive bedrooms or they get unhappy.
